title: Grande Oaks Golf Club

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Grande Oaks Golf Club hosts a number of members-only events each month, and is also available as a private event space. Our plantation-style clubhouse and celebrated golf course, is a sanctuary for members, and a hidden gem for non-members looking for a private event space away from the hustle and bustle of South Florida. The clubhouse veranda features an amazing array of sunset views throughout the year. Grande Oaks Golf Club is the perfect out-of-the-way spot to host a wedding or other private event.
